listing.name: Prv Patchfix
listing.summary: Fixes crashes and restores broken bounties in the prv mod suite.

description:
prv Patchfix

An unofficial bugfix & compatibility patch for the prv mod suite (prv Library, prv Starworks, prv Rust Belt, prv Extraworks, prv Path) by Prav.

> Download here <

Current version: 1.0.2 for Starsector 0.98a-RC8 and prv Starworks v28.6 (probably works on later version of either, no reason it wouldn't)
Dependencies:  prv Library, prv Starworks, prv Rust Belt
Optional dependencies: LunaLib, for the fixes on/off toggles (without it everything default to on)
Save-compatible: safe to add to an existing save, removing it may break the bounties if spawned since the variants won't be there anymore.

Licence thingy

This is a standalone add-on. It does not contain, modify, decompile-and-ship, or redistribute any of Prav's files. The prv .jar files are never modified, shadowed, copied, or redistributed. It fixes a few crashes/bugs entirely from the outside. The prv mods are licensed all rights reserved. This patch was built specifically so it never touches that copyrighted material; it ships none of Prav's code, art, sprites, or text, code is fixed through runtime redirection (I use dependencies to load after his mods, and I tell the game to use my mod's java class instead of his, filter the broken cases, and if it should run I pass it through to the real prv code, I don't recreate the effects or anything, this thing is super light).

To Prav or any rights holder: this is a stopgap made in good faith while the mods are officially unmaintained. If you'd prefer it not exist, or want it handed over / folded in, just say so and it comes down immediately.

Known issues: Several crashes reside inside the original compiled code and can only be fixed by changing that code, which the prv license does not allow, so they are left untouched. Notably a Swarm-host ship dying in the simulator or the Limit Break system on a ship with 8+ weapon groups.

What it fixes

Flicker Core combat crash: fix a crash during battle when a phase-hull ship that has no phase-cloak system mounts a Flicker Core (like this one).
Restored 4 broken bounties: four MagicBounties were being deleted at load because they referenced fleet-preset variant ids that were never shipped, so they never appeared in-game. The patch supplies the 6 missing variant files so the bounties load normally again: prv_morker_rare, prv_aska_au_rare (Starworks) and prv_gremlin_rb_rare_hybrid, prv_wolf_rb_rare (Rust Belt).

Version history

1.0.2 (2026-07-06): first actual release: Flicker Core crash fix and restored bounties.
